items.title: A Repair Estimate Is Not Necessarily a Notice of Bad Faith in Louisiana
items.summary: This is a Louisiana case, so it is persuasive only in Missouri. The article asks whether a contractor's repair estimate, sent after a hurricane and far higher than what the insurer paid, starts the clock for the insurer to fix its payment before bad faith penalties apply. The insured sued after sixty days passed and sought those penalties. The excerpt does not give the answer, so the full article is worth a read.

items.title: WR Berkley Reports Q3 Net Income Decrease, Operating Income Up
items.summary: W.R. Berkley reported third quarter 2026 net income down about 12.7% from a year ago, to about $446 million. Operating income was $456.5 million, which the report describes as up from the earlier period. This is one signal of how a large commercial insurer is doing.

items.title: Washington Commissioner Fines Insurers, Producers $495,200
items.summary: Washington's insurance commissioner reported fines totaling $495,200 against insurance companies, agencies and producers for violations of insurance law between April and August.
